summary.en: Militant attacks continue in northwest Pakistan, where ten police officers and 18 fighters were killed in a recent assault. In Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, security forces killed 74 terrorists during operations, while a separate attack on a Mastung post resulted in three terrorists killed and two civilians dead. Iranian forces claim to have destroyed a US radar site in Bahrain, and the IRGC says it destroyed the same radar after the attack on southern Iran. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Militantangrep fortsetter i nordvest-Pakistan, hvor ti politifolk og 18 kampere ble drept i et nylig angrep. I Khyber Pakhtunkhwa drepte sikkerhetsstyrkene 74 terrorister under operasjoner, mens et separat angrep på en Mastung-post resulterte i tre terrorister drept og to sivile døde. Iranske styrker hevder å ha ødelagt en amerikansk radarsstasjon i Bahrain, og IRGC sier at den ødela samme radar etter angrepet på sørlige Iran. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
